entities.summary: Tukaram Omble AC was an Indian police officer and a former member of the Indian army who served as an assistant sub-inspector (ASI) of the Mumbai Police. He was killed in action during the 26/11 attacks, at Girgaum Chowpatty in Mumbai. The Indian government posthumously honoured Omble on 26 January 2009 with the Ashoka Chakra, the country's highest peacetime military award.
